questions.question: How do I get a barangay clearance?
questions.answer: You can apply for a barangay clearance through the Barangay E-Governance System. Fill out the application form, upload the required documents, and pay the processing fee in person at the barangay hall. Once approved, you can pick it up at the barangay hall.
questions.tagalog_question: Paano ako makakakuha ng barangay clearance?
questions.tagalog_answer: Maaari kang mag-apply para sa barangay clearance sa pamamagitan ng Barangay E-Governance System. Punan ang application form, i-upload ang mga kinakailangang dokumento, at bayaran ang processing fee sa barangay hall. Kapag naaprubahan, maaari mo itong kunin sa barangay hall.

questions.question: What are the requirements for a barangay clearance?
questions.answer:
Requirements include:

- Valid ID (uploaded as a scanned copy)
- Proof of residence (uploaded as a scanned copy of a utility bill, lease agreement, etc.)
- Payment for the processing fee must be made in person at the barangay hall.
questions.tagalog_question: Ano ang mga kinakailangan para sa barangay clearance?
questions.tagalog_answer:
Ang mga kinakailangan ay:

- Valid ID (i-upload bilang scanned copy)
- Patunay ng paninirahan (i-upload bilang scanned copy ng utility bill, lease agreement, atbp.)
- Ang bayad para sa processing fee ay kailangang bayaran nang personal sa barangay hall.

questions.question: How much is the fee for a barangay clearance?
questions.answer: The fee is displayed in the Barangay E-Governance System during the application process. It typically ranges from ₱50 to ₱200, depending on your barangay’s ordinance. Payment must be made in person at the barangay hall.
questions.tagalog_question: Magkano ang bayad para sa barangay clearance?
questions.tagalog_answer: Ang bayad ay makikita sa Barangay E-Governance System habang nag-aapply. Karaniwan itong nasa pagitan ng ₱50 hanggang ₱200, depende sa ordinansa ng inyong barangay. Kailangang bayaran ito nang personal sa barangay hall.

questions.question: How long does it take to process a barangay clearance?
questions.answer: Processing usually takes 1–2 business days. You will receive a notification in the email once your clearance is ready for pickup.
questions.tagalog_question: Gaano katagal ang proseso para sa barangay clearance?
questions.tagalog_answer: Karaniwang tumatagal ng 1–2 araw ng trabaho ang proseso. Makakatanggap ka ng abiso sa email kapag handa na ang iyong clearance para kunin.

questions.question: Can I apply for a barangay clearance online?
questions.answer: Yes, you can apply through the Barangay E-Governance System. Visit the official website to start the application.
questions.tagalog_question: Maaari ba akong mag-apply para sa barangay clearance online?
questions.tagalog_answer: Oo, maaari kang mag-apply sa pamamagitan ng Barangay E-Governance System. Bisitahin ang opisyal na website upang simulan ang aplikasyon.

questions.question: How do I file a complaint in the barangay?
questions.answer: Log in to the Barangay E-Governance System and navigate to the 'Complaints' section. Fill out the complaint form, attach any supporting documents, and submit your report. You will be notified of the next steps through the system.

questions.question: What is a Barangay Clearance?
questions.answer: A Barangay Clearance is an official document issued by the barangay certifying that an individual is a resident of the barangay and has no pending issues or complaints.
questions.tagalog_question: Ano ang Barangay Clearance?
questions.tagalog_answer: Ang Barangay Clearance ay isang opisyal na dokumento na inisyu ng barangay na nagpapatunay na ang isang indibidwal ay residente ng barangay at walang mga nakabinbing isyu o reklamo.

questions.question: How do I apply for a Barangay Clearance?
questions.answer: You can apply for a Barangay Clearance by visiting the barangay hall or through the Barangay E-Governance System. Fill out the application form, provide the necessary documents, and pay the required fee.
questions.tagalog_question: Paano ako mag-aapply para sa Barangay Clearance?
questions.tagalog_answer: Maaari kang mag-apply para sa Barangay Clearance sa pamamagitan ng pagbisita sa barangay hall o sa pamamagitan ng Barangay E-Governance System. Punan ang application form, ibigay ang mga kinakailangang dokumento, at bayaran ang kinakailangang bayad.

questions.question: What are the requirements for a Barangay Clearance?
questions.answer: Requirements include a valid ID, proof of residence, and payment of the processing fee.
questions.tagalog_question: Ano ang mga kinakailangan para sa Barangay Clearance?
questions.tagalog_answer: Ang mga kinakailangan ay isang valid ID, patunay ng paninirahan, at pagbabayad ng processing fee.

questions.question: What is a Certificate of Indigency?
questions.answer: A Certificate of Indigency is a document issued by the barangay to certify that an individual or family is financially incapable and in need of assistance.
questions.tagalog_question: Ano ang Certificate of Indigency?
questions.tagalog_answer: Ang Certificate of Indigency ay isang dokumento na inisyu ng barangay upang patunayan na ang isang indibidwal o pamilya ay walang kakayahang pinansyal at nangangailangan ng tulong.

questions.question: How do I apply for a Certificate of Indigency?
questions.answer: Visit the barangay hall or use the Barangay E-Governance System to apply. Submit the required documents and fill out the application form.
questions.tagalog_question: Paano ako mag-aapply para sa Certificate of Indigency?
questions.tagalog_answer: Bisitahin ang barangay hall o gamitin ang Barangay E-Governance System upang mag-apply. Isumite ang mga kinakailangang dokumento at punan ang application form.

questions.question: What are the requirements for a Certificate of Indigency?
questions.answer: Requirements include a valid ID, proof of residence, and a letter of request stating the purpose of the certificate.
questions.tagalog_question: Ano ang mga kinakailangan para sa Certificate of Indigency?
questions.tagalog_answer: Ang mga kinakailangan ay isang valid ID, patunay ng paninirahan, at isang liham ng kahilingan na nagsasaad ng layunin ng sertipiko.

questions.question: What is a Certificate of Residency?
questions.answer: A Certificate of Residency is an official document issued by the barangay certifying that an individual is a resident of the barangay.
questions.tagalog_question: Ano ang Certificate of Residency?
questions.tagalog_answer: Ang Certificate of Residency ay isang opisyal na dokumento na inisyu ng barangay na nagpapatunay na ang isang indibidwal ay residente ng barangay.

questions.question: How do I apply for a Certificate of Residency?
questions.answer: You can apply for a Certificate of Residency by visiting the barangay hall or through the Barangay E-Governance System. Fill out the application form and provide the necessary documents.
questions.tagalog_question: Paano ako mag-aapply para sa Certificate of Residency?
questions.tagalog_answer: Maaari kang mag-apply para sa Certificate of Residency sa pamamagitan ng pagbisita sa barangay hall o sa pamamagitan ng Barangay E-Governance System. Punan ang application form at ibigay ang mga kinakailangang dokumento.

questions.question: What are the requirements for a Certificate of Residency?
questions.answer: Requirements include a valid ID and proof of residence.
questions.tagalog_question: Ano ang mga kinakailangan para sa Certificate of Residency?
questions.tagalog_answer: Ang mga kinakailangan ay isang valid ID at patunay ng paninirahan.
